shared_analysis.analysis_rationale: The patch adds an explicit guard rejecting zero `sp->h_sampling` or `sp->v_sampling` immediately after loading them from `td->td_ycbcrsubsampling[]` in `libtiff/tif_jpeg.c`. The new error path calls `TIFFErrorExt(...)` and returns `0`, indicating these values are later relied on as divisors or in arithmetic that requires nonzero sampling factors. No memory lifecycle or stale-handle behavior is changed; the concrete fix is input validation for invalid zero dimensions/sampling factors.
